'''Venram Krax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] operating in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was the uncle of [[Tehlan Aleece]], and after she escaped during his [[Birthday/Legends|birthday]] party on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], he put out a reward for her return. It was unknown if he was aware of her [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activities.
